site.title: Learn Napplets
site.strapline: A field guide to authority boundaries and evidence status
site.scopeNote: This is a dependency-free conceptual learning surface. It does not run a host, guest napplet, package, relay, wallet, signer, or browser lab.

FACT-HOST-BOUNDARY-001.label: Authority boundary teaching model
FACT-HOST-BOUNDARY-001.statement: Authority stays with the host; a focused untrusted napplet receives only declared mediated capabilities.
FACT-HOST-BOUNDARY-001.uncertaintyReason: This is a project-policy mental model for the learning surface, not a verified upstream runtime rule.
FACT-HOST-BOUNDARY-001.refreshTrigger: Refresh if the project evidence policy changes or reviewed direct authority changes the teaching boundary.

FACT-STATIC-SCOPE-001.label: Static-site scope boundary
FACT-STATIC-SCOPE-001.statement: This site is a static explanation, not a runtime: it does not execute a host or guest, install a package, contact a relay, or hold wallet or signing authority.
FACT-STATIC-SCOPE-001.uncertaintyReason: The owner-authorized exception is narrow and does not accept an ADR, runtime, package, deployment, or Phase 2 transition.
FACT-STATIC-SCOPE-001.refreshTrigger: Refresh if the approved static-site scope or evidence policy changes.

FACT-LEARNING-PATH-001.label: Deterministic reading path
FACT-LEARNING-PATH-001.statement: Follow one note journey as a reading exercise: compose, identify the authority boundary, inspect a mediated request/result model, then inspect the evidence status behind each assertion.
FACT-LEARNING-PATH-001.uncertaintyReason: This is a deterministic learning sequence, not an observation of a selected runtime or protocol flow.
FACT-LEARNING-PATH-001.refreshTrigger: Refresh if the site content contract or approved learning scope changes.

CLM-NAP-INTENT-20260731.label: NAP-INTENT draft claim
CLM-NAP-INTENT-20260731.statement: A draft names NAP-INTENT, an archetype intent dispatcher, and a NIP-5D web binding. It does not resolve direct NIP-5D authority or compatibility.
CLM-NAP-INTENT-20260731.uncertaintyReason: The repository-local draft cannot settle its referenced NIP-5D binding, runtime behavior, or cross-implementation compatibility.
CLM-NAP-INTENT-20260731.refreshTrigger: Re-fetch only if the cited napplet/naps head changes after 2026-07-31, the pinned blob becomes unavailable, or review requires a different source scope.

CLM-NAPPLET-WEB-20260731.label: napplet/web alpha claim
CLM-NAPPLET-WEB-20260731.statement: napplet/web describes its own alpha SDK and shell model. It is not NAP/NIP authority, a package qualification, or runtime/browser proof.
CLM-NAPPLET-WEB-20260731.uncertaintyReason: Repository implementation prose and mutable PR direction cannot establish normative behavior, published-artifact integrity, or browser support.
CLM-NAPPLET-WEB-20260731.refreshTrigger: Re-fetch only if the cited napplet/web head changes after 2026-07-31, the pinned blob becomes unavailable, or review requires a different source scope.

CLM-KEHTO-WEB-PAJA-20260731.label: Paja implementation claim
CLM-KEHTO-WEB-PAJA-20260731.statement: Paja documents local authoring/testing, live-relay defaults, and a memory fixture mode. This does not select a teaching host or qualify a runtime.
CLM-KEHTO-WEB-PAJA-20260731.uncertaintyReason: Live-service defaults and a deterministic fixture option do not demonstrate compatibility, a safe teaching-host profile, or NAP/NIP requirements.
CLM-KEHTO-WEB-PAJA-20260731.refreshTrigger: Re-fetch only if the cited kehto/web head changes after 2026-07-31, the pinned blob becomes unavailable, or review requires a different source scope.

CLM-NAMPLETS-NATIVE-20260731.label: Nampplets native-reference claim
CLM-NAMPLETS-NATIVE-20260731.statement: Nampplets is an in-progress native reference with an unratified compatibility lock. It does not qualify web, portable, package, or NAP/NIP behavior.
CLM-NAMPLETS-NATIVE-20260731.uncertaintyReason: A native reference host cannot establish web-runtime behavior, package admission, portable-target eligibility, or a selected teaching host.
CLM-NAMPLETS-NATIVE-20260731.refreshTrigger: Re-fetch only if the cited Nampplets head changes after 2026-07-31, the pinned blob becomes unavailable, or review requires a different source scope.

TERM-NIP-5D.definition: No current authoritative definition is recorded; do not infer scope, transport, sandbox, sender, manifest, or identity behavior.

REL-HOST-GUEST-MENTAL-MODEL-001.label: Conceptual mediated authority path

steps.action: A note is considered in a conceptual learning scenario; this site does not create or send it.
A focused guest asks for a declared capability rather than possessing host authority.
The host evaluates policy and may mediate the request; no host runs in this static site.
A bounded result returns to the guest model; protocol envelopes and runtime behavior remain unresolved.

REL-HOST-GUEST-MENTAL-MODEL-001.transcript: Conceptual transcript: a learner considers a note; an untrusted guest requests a declared capability; a trusted host policy boundary mediates or declines; a bounded result is shown. This transcript is a static teaching model, not a runtime capture.
REL-HOST-GUEST-MENTAL-MODEL-001.refreshTrigger: Refresh if approved authority-boundary policy or reviewed direct upstream evidence changes the model.

OQ-UPSTREAM-BASELINE-001.statement: Direct authoritative NIP-5D and NAP registry/projection evidence remains missing or unreviewed. Do not state a protocol rule or selected architecture.

CMP-BASELINE-001.label: Runtime, browser, and teaching host
CMP-BASELINE-001.statement: No common qualified runtime or cross-browser result exists. Implementation observations do not close this gap.

DRF-CONFORMANCE-001.label: Conformance and native qualification
DRF-CONFORMANCE-001.statement: Do not infer conformance from native-reference text or README tooling descriptions.

home.title: Authority, without pretending certainty
home.lead: Read the authority boundary first. Then inspect the evidence that limits what this site can safely say.

learn.title: A note journey, read in order
learn.lead: This route is a static sequence. It makes the authority boundary inspectable without a live service or runtime.

architecture.title: The host keeps authority
architecture.lead: A precise boundary is more useful than an imaginary integration. This page is a labeled project-policy teaching model.

sources.title: Evidence, with its limits attached
sources.lead: Every essential claim retains its authority tier, evidence class, maturity, state, uncertainty, source identity, and refresh trigger.
